name: Gigils: Chomp Together
description:
About This Game

HUNT, EAT, EVOLVE!

Hunt bugs scattered across the map, devour your enemies, and collect the energy you need to grow. The more you eat, the stronger you become — but getting bigger also makes you a much easier target.

Keep moving, choose your fights carefully, and do not let the enemy team turn you into their next meal.

CHOOSE YOUR GIGIL!

Play as one of four unique Gigils, each with its own playstyle, strengths, and abilities.

Whether you prefer charging directly into battle, supporting your teammates, disrupting the enemy team, or striking when nobody expects it, there is a Gigil for you.

Experiment with different abilities and find a combination that fits the way you play.

FIGHT TOGETHER!

Gigils may be hungry, but surviving alone is not easy.

Coordinate with your team, focus dangerous enemies, and fight for control of important areas. A well-organized group can overwhelm even the largest opponent.

Teamwork wins matches - although stealing your friend's food is sometimes difficult to resist.

CAPTURE THE BATTLEFIELD! 

Growing stronger is important, but size alone will not win the match. Push with your team, defend captured positions, and know when to abandon a fight before you become someone else's upgrade.

Every match is a constant struggle between fighting, feeding, and controlling the map.

RIDE, THROW, AND CAUSE CHAOS!

Not every creature on the map is just food.

Find rideable creatures and use them as vehicles, weapons, or unexpected tools of destruction. Charge into battle, surprise the enemy team, or turn the local wildlife into part of your strategy.

The battlefield is filled with opportunities - and most of them have teeth.

ENTER THE FOOD CHAIN!

Bite your enemies. Protect your team. Grow into the biggest creature on the battlefield.

Just remember: no matter how large you become, there is always something hungry nearby.
short_desc: Gigils is a fast-paced brawler where cute alien creatures bite, evolve, and fight for control of the battlefield. Choose your Gigil, devour enemies, unlock powerful abilities, and grow into a bigger threat. Play solo or work with your team, capture key locations, and turn the chaos in your favor.
